map.24 点求解穷举三运算符组合：从 4 个数字中任选 2 个做四则运算（加、减、乘: Solving 24 by exhaustive search over three-operator combinations: from the 4 numbers pick any 2 and apply an arithmetic operation (add, subtract, multiply, divide, with the divisor never zero) to get an intermediate value, then keep combining it with the remaining numbers until one value is left; if that value equals 24 (floating-point tolerance 1e-6) it is a solution. Operators and bracket structures are enumerated one by one so no solution is missed.
map.📚 深度解析：用四张扑克牌点数经加、减、乘、除与括号组合凑成 24，本工具枚举可: 📚 In-depth: combine the pips of four playing cards with addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and parentheses to reach 24. This tool enumerates the feasible expressions or proves there is none, supporting arithmetic drills and logical thinking.
map.随机发牌：系统发四张牌，求能否凑 24。: Random deal: the tool deals four cards; decide whether they can make 24.

map.无解判定：给出不可行提示与思路。: No-solution check: reports infeasibility with hints.
map.示例：输入 3 3 8 8，经典解 8 ÷ (3 − 8 ÷ 3) = 24。: Example: enter 3 3 8 8; the classic solution is 8 ÷ (3 − 8 ÷ 3) = 24.
map.四数各用一次，可加減乘除并加括号，结果等于 24 即胜。: Each of the four numbers is used once with +, -, x, / and parentheses; a result of 24 wins.
map.中间步骤允许分数，最终等于 24 即可，如上述 8/3 用法。: Fractions are permitted in intermediate steps as long as the final value is 24, as in the 8/3 case above.
